#!/bin/bash

# Function to count references to an exported function
count_refs() {
    local func_name="$1"
    local file_path="$2"
    
    # Count all occurrences of the function call, excluding the definition
    # We look for the function name followed by ( or space
    local total=$(grep -r "\b${func_name}(" /bench/repo --include="*.go" | wc -l)
    
    # Count the definition (should be 1)
    local def=$(grep "^func ${func_name}(" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)

    local refs=$((total - def))
    
    if [ $refs -lt 0 ]; then

    echo "$refs|$func_name|$file_path"
}

# Extract all exported functions with their paths
while IFS=: read -r file line rest; do
